CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)

   B. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.
